name: discobox-mcp
description: Launch and work with Discobox boxes through live terminals, files, and desktop views.

endpoint.title: Discobox connection URL
endpoint.description: Your host's unix:///absolute/path/to/server.sock, an HTTP(S) API origin, or an enrolled discobox:// peer URL. This is the Discobox API, not the adapter's /mcp endpoint.

project.title: Discobox project
project.description: The Discobox project whose boxes you want to work with.

api_token.title: Discobox API token (if required)
api_token.description: Optional upstream Discobox API credential. This is not the bearer token for a separately running MCP adapter.
